mapping_regression_tests.scope: exact provider context codes and codexErrorInfo map to 400; other errors retain 503

limitations: The gate proves automatic SDK compaction after the mapped error, not that genuine oversized history and its summary request fit the native model window.
The tiny fixture grew from pre_tokens=2416 to post_tokens=2487; no real long-context reduction was tested.
All fake response usage is synthetic and excluded from formal experiments.
Failed exec requests without token events must be reported as usage unknown, not zero.
CLI native compaction and internal samples may have usage that the exec JSON interface does not report.
